title: Spectral spaces are exactly inverse limits of finite sober spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterizes spectral spaces as inverse limits of directed systems of finite sober topological spaces (author lemma at source lines 4920-4924, label lemma-spectral-inverse-limit-finite-sober-spaces). The proof (source lines 4926-4944) takes one direction from the previous limit lemma, embeds the spectral space into a product of two-point spaces as a constructibly closed subset, presents the product as a cofiltered limit over finite index subsets and identifies the space with the limit of its images (proof lines 4926-4943). The embedding and identification are the substance; note that the author records the last two identifications as a detail omitted and a formal argument omitted, which is why this card is registered at the lower level with that fact stated openly. H2.
